title: Linux: .ase palette files missing from swatch-library file picker
notes: Varve parses ASE/GPL/ACO/ACT in packages/shared/src/paletteFormats.ts but no editor surface imports it, so there is no palette file picker to omit the extension. Adding palette import is a product decision, not a defect fix.

title: Dragging stroke color over fill color does nothing.
notes: Drag a colour between the fill and stroke indicators to copy it. Varve has fill/stroke swatches but drag-to-copy was not verified; the same request appears as #2223 in the frozen corpus.

title: [Bug Report] [VectorCraft] The save button does not render anything on the mask layer
notes: Reporter is Windows 11 and the wording is ambiguous (saving masked artwork does not render on the main canvas). Needs the attached screenshots and a reproduction before it can be judged against Varve's mask render/persist path; labelled needs info upstream.

title: [Bug Report] [VectorCraft] Vectorcraft Taskbar Bug
notes: Full-screen window treating the Windows taskbar as app area. Varve's window chrome is Tauri-managed, not the egui viewport this report describes.
